title: 2002 HMMT February Calculus Problem 5
statement: What is the minimum vertical distance between the graphs of \(2+\sin (x)\) and \(\cos (x)\) ?

solutions.text: The derivative of \(2+\sin (x)-\cos (x)\) is \(\cos x+\sin x\), which in the interval \(0 \leq x<2 \pi\) is zero at \(x=\frac{3 \pi}{4}, \frac{7 \pi}{4}\). At \(\frac{7 \pi}{4}\), when \(\sin (x)\) is negative and \(\cos (x)\) is positive, the distance reaches its minimal value of \(2-\sqrt{2}\).
